title: Encounter
build: Novagen release as a PC64 program file (ENCOUNTR.P00), crunched; no trainer; possibly a crack (the level-select check is NOPed and seven junk bytes run at game start)

dont_miss.text: Top-down replays of the attract demo and five enemies, pass by pass, from positions read out of the running game.

tools.emulator: VICE 3.10 via vice-mcp 3.11.0 (macOS arm64 GUI build)

exclude: zero page, initialised from the image at $8B00
loader residue and unused RAM below the object tables
view character buffers, rebuilt every frame
unreferenced bytes between the object tables and the shape scripts
unreferenced tail after the shape scripts
extra: sprite frames: gun sight, ground strip, mound; sprite pointers B
title and game-over screens, prebuilt, with hidden variables

regions: per-object working tables: view list, bearings, velocities, previous positions, speeds
224 shape scripts: 7 families x 32 size steps, moved here from $3E00 by the init
two view character buffers with their ground mirrors, rebuilt every frame
play screen A: status row, view rows, console
play screen B rows with four sprite frames (shot, gun sight, ground strip, mound)
title and game-over screens, prebuilt in the wide font
32 sprite frames: saucers, hills, clouds, dot fields
character set: small font, wide font, console, logo fills
RESET vectors and the CBM80 cartridge signature
nine 16-byte scene records: band colours and sprite flags per level
object position, state, type and heading arrays
reciprocal, arctangent, hypotenuse, range-to-size, quarter sine, obelisk grid map
score, high score, enemy count, points table
enemy fire scripts, saucer and missile parameter tables, explosion colours, backdrop sprite tables, skill tables
shape script pointers, low then high
narrow column-shape profile rows and per-level backdrop records
